verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs explicitly list a workflow to "Reproduce issues, narrow the root cause, and verify the fix". The verify-the-fix step is well backed: cloud agents start dev servers, click through UI flows, verify changes, and attach screenshots, videos and logs, and the service-accounts docs describe a Sentry error triggering an agent to investigate and fix the issue. missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on how issue reproduction and root-cause narrowing work (only a one-line heading), independent or hands-on corroboration of the debugging workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reproduce issues, narrow down root causes, and verify fixes

citations.quote: Reproduce issues, narrow the root cause, and verify the fix
Agents can start dev servers, open the app in a browser, click through UI flows, and verify their changes work before pushing a PR.
Agents create artifacts such as screenshots, videos, and log references to demonstrate their work.
An error in Sentry initiating a cloud agent to investigate and fix the issue
